question: In Table 3, how much lower is the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading with the least heat than that of the bare material, and how much higher is its onset temperature?
rendered: According to Table 3, the bare material has an onset temperature of 231.93°C and a heat generation of 666.42 J/g. The ZrO2 loading with the least heat has an onset temperature of 245.31°C and a heat generation of 446.25 J/g. Therefore, the heat generation of the ZrO2 loading is 220.17 J/g lower than that of the bare material, and its onset temperature is 13.38°C higher.
